_note: Hand-maintained notes on the amending Acts, keyed by instrument_id. The parser never edits the source wording; anything wrong in the print is recorded here instead, so the tree keeps saying what the Act says and the reader still learns what is off about it. Mirrors data/processed/canonical-overrides.json, which does the same for the principal statutes.
